llm.summary: This skill is a coherent educational prompt generator with no hidden execution, persistence, credential use, or network behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The frontmatter allows Read, Write, Edit, and AskUserQuestion, while the instructions only clearly need user questioning and prompt generation; no artifact instruction directs file mutation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains markdown files only and no executable scripts, installers, package hooks, or runtime setup commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad style terms that could invoke the skill unexpectedly, but those terms are visibly related to the supported visual styles and do not introduce hidden or unsafe behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, credential/session access, broad indexing, network calls, or privilege escalation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s stated purpose is to generate notebook-style educational image prompts, and the artifact content is consistently focused on visual style, layout, education-card templates, and examples.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should know this skill is mainly a prompt-writing aid for educational knowledge cards. The broad Chinese visual-style triggers may activate it when a user only mentions anime, cute, or pink styles, so review routing behavior if accidental invocation would be disruptive.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are style-related and disclosed, but they may cause accidental invocation for generic anime or pink-style requests; this is a usability/scoping concern rather than a security hold.
